title: Trumbauer's influence on Lester Young and Benny Carter
summary: Benny Carter and Lester Young both told him Trumbauer was an idol, Lester copying his C-melody sound, and Norvo says to compare the records.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound
